sections.title: Results & Impact
sections.executive_summary: AMCUI transformed the company's UI development by establishing a unified design system used across 50+ applications. The component library achieved 99% design consistency and reduced UI development time by 250%, while ensuring WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance.

sections.title: Design System Success
highlights: 100+ reusable components built with Preact and TypeScript
50+ applications using the unified design system
250% faster UI development compared to custom implementation
99% design consistency score across all platforms

sections.title: Business Results
sections.summary: AMCUI eliminated duplicated UI efforts across teams, enabling designers to hand off work to developers in hours instead of days. The Storybook documentation became the single source of truth, reducing design-dev miscommunication by 85%.
